title: Dependence on relevant coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$. For each coordinate $i$, define its influence as the uniform average of the square of the discrete derivative obtained by setting coordinate $i$ to $1$ and to $-1$, respectively, and taking half their difference; call $i$ relevant when this influence is positive. Then $f(x)=f(y)$ whenever $x$ and $y$ agree on every relevant coordinate.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
caveat: The snippet does not include the definition of DependsOn, so the usual meaning—agreement on the specified coordinates implies equal function values—is assumed.
